about.title: About this Project
about.methodology_text: We crawl DBLP via SPARQL and OpenReview for first author names of papers published at ~416 CCF-rated CS conferences (2010-2026), then classify names into 17 language groups using an ensemble of fastText language detection and rule-based surname matching.
about.disclaimer_text: Names are terrible predictors of language. We did it anyway. This is meant as a fun, light-hearted visualization — not a rigorous sociolinguistic study. No discrimination intended.
about.src_dblp: Author names, publication data, and venue information
about.src_openreview: Supplementary paper data and acceptance rates for AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, etc.) — often available months before DBLP
about.src_ccf_pdf: Conference list, CCF rankings and categories (extracted from official PDFs)
about.src_fasttext: fastText lid.176.bin model for name-to-language classification
about.src_or_affiliation: First-author institution data from author profiles (current-year conferences)
about.src_martenlienen: Pre-compiled affiliation dataset for NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR (2006-2024)
about.src_papercopilot: Pre-compiled affiliation data for ICLR, CoRL, and other conferences (2023+)
about.src_openalex: First-author institution data via title matching. Coverage varies by publisher.
about.affiliation_accuracy_text: Affiliation data is sourced from multiple providers with varying coverage. Historical data (NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR) uses pre-compiled datasets with 85-99% coverage. Current-year data uses OpenReview profiles. Other conferences use OpenAlex, where coverage depends on publisher: IEEE/ACM/Springer conferences typically have 70-90% coverage. The coverage percentage shown on each conference page indicates data completeness.
about.accuracy_text: Name-based language inference is inherently imprecise. Many factors (immigration, marriage, cultural mixing) make names unreliable indicators. Treat all results as rough approximations.
about.data_cleaning_intro: The raw DBLP data undergoes extensive cleaning before analysis:
about.clean_workshop: Workshop filtering — Keyword and abbreviation pattern detection (e.g., ICCVW, DSN-W) removes co-located workshop papers
about.clean_proceedings: Proceedings volume filtering — Removes editor entries, frontmatter, "Revised Selected Papers", and other non-paper records
about.clean_crossyear: Cross-year deduplication — Resolves publication-year vs. conference-year mismatches in DBLP using URI-based year extraction
about.clean_joint: Joint conference deduplication — Detects and removes double-counted papers from joint events (e.g., EMNLP/CoNLL, ACL/IJCNLP)
about.clean_colocation: Co-location cleanup — Separates main conference papers from co-located events sharing a single DBLP entry
about.clean_gapfill: Gap filling — Recovers missing data via DBLP Search API, OpenReview API, HTML scraping, journal supplements, and conference website APIs
about.open_data_text: The cleaned dataset (909k+ first-author records across 413 conferences, 2010–2026) is freely available for download on

finances.title: Financial Analysis
finances.compare_hint: Overlay other conferences to compare their sponsoring organizations' finances.
finances.unavailable_note: Registration revenue for this conference is collected by its co-sponsoring society and is not separately disclosed, so conference-level financials are unavailable.
finances.source_note: Source: IRS Form 990 via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
finances.unit_note: All figures in USD. Fiscal-year data mapped to conference years; see notes per conference.
finances.compare_empty: Select at least one conference to compare.
finances.filing_hint: Original filings and extracted reports, kept for traceability. 'manual' = extracted directly from the filing PDF ahead of ProPublica digitization.
finances.transcript_note: Report extracted from the scanned filing via AI vision read; every headline figure cross-checked against the filing's own totals (Parts I, VIII, IX, X).
finances.annual_hint: Three AI-generated findings per fiscal year, plus revenue/expense composition where the filing discloses it.
finances.mix_none: No composition data disclosed for this year.

mix_desc.contributions: All contributions, gifts, grants and sponsorships (Part VIII line 1h).
mix_desc.program: Program service revenue — mainly registration fees (Part VIII line 9).
mix_desc.investment: Interest, dividends and net gains from securities (Part VIII lines 3+7d).
mix_desc.royalties: Royalties, e.g. publication and content licensing (Part VIII line 5).
mix_desc.misc: Miscellaneous revenue not fitting other lines — for NeurIPS: hotel rebates, registration refunds, shared expense.
mix_desc.conferences: Venues, catering, AV production for the conference (Part IX line 19).
mix_desc.professional_fees: Non-employee fees: management, legal, accounting and other services (Part IX line 11).
mix_desc.occupancy: Rent, utilities and facility costs (Part IX line 16).
mix_desc.grants: Grants and assistance paid to organizations or individuals (Part IX lines 1-3).
mix_desc.awards: Prize and award payments (Part IX line 24b).
mix_desc.salaries_wages: Salaries and wages of staff (Part IX line 7).
mix_desc.officer_key_employee_compensation: Compensation of officers, directors and key employees (Part IX line 5).
mix_desc.information_technology: IT services — paper/review systems, registration platforms.
mix_desc.accounting_fees: Accounting and audit fees (Part IX line 11c).
mix_desc.grants_domestic_individuals: Assistance to domestic individuals, e.g. travel grants (Part IX line 2).
mix_desc.grants_foreign: Assistance to foreign individuals/organizations (Part IX line 3).
mix_desc.interest: Interest paid on debt and borrowings (Part IX line 20).
mix_desc.board_meetings: Board of directors meeting and travel expenses (Part IX Section B).
mix_desc.good_works: USENIX Good Works community-benefit project grants (Part IX Section B).
